declared_rules.scope: re-adjudication only. No proposer is re-run for the purpose of proposing: 48's screens are re-executed ONLY to recover proposal MEMBERSHIPS, which 48 did not store for non-candidate rows, and the recovered population is verified identical to 48's before anything is guarded (see verification.regeneration). 49's 130 proposals are read from its JSON.
declared_rules.P1_guard: duplicate-referent guard, label-free and distinct from R15. Normalisation: strip ONE leading space if present, then lowercase. Two members are duplicates iff their normalised strings are (i) equal, or (ii) one is a prefix of the other and the shorter has length >= 3, or (iii) Levenshtein distance <= 1. DROP RULE (operationalised here; P1 says only 'the lower-count member is dropped', which is not order-invariant for chains): within a proposal, define each member's key as (corpus count, -pool index); while any duplicate pair remains among the surviving members, drop the member with the globally smallest key among all members that are the lower-key half of at least one live duplicate pair; repeat. This is deterministic and independent of member order. NOTE (declared, not softened): rule (iii) makes every pair of single-character normalised strings duplicates, so any proposal built from single letters collapses to k = 1. That is what the frozen rule says and it is applied as written.
declared_rules.P2_adjudicator: saturated-cell adjudication by the R16 channel-3 conjunct. A proposal is P2-ELIGIBLE iff, after the P1 guard: k <= 10 (P2's bound, which is also R16's declared-conjunct bound); closure gap_ratio < 2.5; rho == 1.0; all k leave-one-out subsets close (gap_ratio < 2.5); and the tier's verdict is NOT ADJUDICABLE BECAUSE a cell is saturated (p99 == 1.0) -- either the k cell or the (k-1) LOO cell. PASS_P2 := P2-eligible AND channel 3 (OV retention) > the 99th percentile of 500 random-k planes at that layer AND the frequency-matched arm passes AND the stored permuted-search mean < 0.5. The cell's conditional exact-1.0 rate is reported for every P2 row. PASS_P2 is reported SEPARATELY from R14 PASS and is never merged into it. k >= 11 saturated rows stay NOT ADJUDICABLE: P2's k <= 10 bound governs.
declared_rules.P2_multiplicity: expected false PASS_P2 = 0.01 x (number of P2-adjudicated proposals), reported per source.
declared_rules.tier: imported by path from scripts/48_agreement_graph_screen.py: closure first (gap_ratio < 2.5), then the R14 order conjunct against the stricter of the ch1-drawn and ch2-drawn exact cluster-like cells with the per-k screen tie class (48's D5), then LOO closure and LOO order at the (k-1) ch1 cell (48's D1), then the frequency-matched arm (200 count-matched k-sets, +-0.25 log10), then the stored permuted-search mean. Channel 3 recomputed here with 48's Channel3 for BOTH sources; 49's stored channel3_ov_retention is not used.
declared_rules.tie_class: For SOURCE 48, R14's tie class is recomputed on the GUARDED population per (layer, proposer, k): guarding moves k downward, so 48's stored screen_max_rho_by_k no longer describes the population being adjudicated. For SOURCE 49 the tie-class clause is DISABLED and the order conjunct is decided by the cell p99 alone. Reason (declared here): 49's screen population per (layer, tau) is 2-33 proposals, so 'rho >= the screen's per-k maximum' is satisfied BY CONSTRUCTION by every proposal that is the only one at its k -- the clause would be vacuous and strictly permissive. 49's own tier likewise had no tie-class clause. The per-k maxima are still reported.
declared_rules.permuted_search: reported AS STORED from 48. Not re-run: the guard was NOT applied inside 48's permuted searches. For proposer A this cannot matter -- the permuted searches produced 0 PASSers (and, at L7, 0 proposals at all), and a guard can only shrink proposals. For proposer B, 48 stored only passers[:10] (empty), not the permuted proposal memberships, so guard+P2 cannot be applied to them; this is stated as a limitation, not run.
deviations: E1 (memberships not stored). 48 stored memberships only for PASS/MARGINAL candidates (2 rows, both the strict-12). Its screens are deterministic functions of the frozen channels, so the full proposal population is REGENERATED here and verified against 48's stored counts, strict-12 hashes, sources and per-(layer, proposer) tallies before any guard is applied. A mismatch aborts the run.

E2 (nulls and plants not guarded). P1 says the guard applies identically to proposals, nulls and plants. Here it is applied to PROPOSALS only: the exact cluster-like cells, the frequency-matched arm draws, the channel-3 random-k planes, the permuted searches and the plants are unguarded. Reason: a guarded null draw has variable k, so a fixed-k cell would no longer exist. Direction of bias: duplicate members inflate a set's rho, so an unguarded null is if anything HARDER to beat than a guarded one -- the deviation is conservative against PASS, not permissive.

E3 (L5 skipped). 49's L5 proposals (64 rows at tau 30/40/45) are NOT re-adjudicated. Channel 2 at L5 is not on disk (results/phase3_lag_action_robust_deltas.npz holds L6/L7 only; results/phase4_lag1_deltas_L*.npz hold L0-L4 and L10) and recomputing it needs 42's cache stream, which R12/R17 forbid while script 47 holds MPS. All 64 stored L5 verdicts were FAIL (closure), and the guard can move closure in either direction, so they are reported as NOT RE-CHECKED.

E4 (49's ring conjunct carried forward). Prereg 2.2's extra conjunct -- the cluster's shared plane > 60 deg from its own type-mean ring plane -- is a function of the occurrence-plane rows, which are not re-streamed here (same R12/R17 reason as E3). Stored ring_conjunct_pass values are carried forward and flagged: for a guarded subset the shared plane would have to be refitted.

E5 (49 tier re-implementation). 49 adjudicated with its own null construction (sampled cluster-like cells, 3 seeds, 6000 draws, plus a count-matched-random cell). Here 49's proposals are run through 48's imported tier (exact enumerated cells). To separate the guard's effect from the tier change, 49's proposals are adjudicated BOTH unguarded and guarded under 48's tier, and both are reported.
